steps.title: Prepare PEG Precipitation Solution
steps.instruction: Prepare a 30% PEG precipitation solution using PEG (M.W 7000-9000), NaCl, and RNase-free water.

substeps.instruction: Add ingredients to a graduated Duran bottle.
Add water to fill up to 200 ml.
Shake vigorously by hand.
Autoclave and mix well while hot (solution turns milky when hot, then clear when cooled).
Store at room temperature.

steps.title: Prepare Soil Samples
steps.instruction: Weigh 0.4 g of soil (range 0.2-0.7 g) into a Lysing Matrix E tube or a 2-ml screw-cap tube containing 0.7 g of 0.1 mm glass beads.

substeps.instruction: Place the tube on ice.

steps.title: Add Lysis Reagents
steps.instruction: Add the appropriate combination of lysis buffers and phenol to the soil tube.

substeps.instruction: Option A (with phenol): Add 375 µL of PB (pH 8.0, pH 5.8, or PB+Al), 125 µL of TNC or TNS, and 400 µL of TE-saturated phenol (if using PB pH 8.0) or water-saturated phenol (if using PB pH 5.8).
Option B (without phenol): Add 675 µL of PB and 225 µL of TNC or TNS.

steps.title: Bead Beating and Lysis
steps.instruction: Homogenize the sample using a sample homogenizer (e.g., FastPrep-24™).

substeps.instruction: Process for 30 seconds at 6.5 m s-1.
Use a CoolPrep™ adapter with dry ice if available; otherwise, chill on ice for 10 seconds immediately after processing.

steps.title: Initial Phase Separation
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the sample at 14,000 rpm at 15 °C for 3 minutes (room temperature is also acceptable).

substeps.instruction: Transfer the entire liquid (both aqueous and organic phases) to a fresh 2 ml tube by decanting or pipetting.

steps.title: Repeat Lysis Cycles
steps.instruction: Repeat the lysis and separation process (Steps 3-7) two more times using the same Lysing Matrix E tube.

substeps.instruction: If the tube is overfilling, decrease phenol volume down to 200 μl.
For the second repetition, collect supernatant in a fresh 2 ml tube.
For the third repetition, divide the supernatant between the two previous collection tubes to achieve equal volumes.

steps.title: Phenol-Chloroform Extraction
steps.instruction: Perform a phenol/chloroform extraction to purify the supernatant.

substeps.instruction: Add 800 µL (or 1 volume) of phenol/chloroform/isoamyl alcohol 25:24:1 to each supernatant tube (max total volume 2 ml).
Mix by hand or vortex.
Centrifuge at 14,000 rpm, 15 °C for 3 minutes.
Carefully transfer the upper aqueous phase to two fresh 2 ml tubes using a 1-ml pipette tip, avoiding the interphase and organic phase.

steps.title: Chloroform-Isoamyl Alcohol Wash
steps.instruction: Wash the aqueous phase with chloroform/isoamyl alcohol.

substeps.instruction: Add 1 volume of chloroform/isoamyl alcohol 24:1 to each tube.
Mix vigorously by hand or vortex.
Centrifuge at 14,000 rpm, 15 °C for 3 minutes.
Carefully transfer the supernatant to fresh 2 ml low-binding microcentrifuge tubes (resulting in two tubes per sample).

steps.title: PEG Precipitation
steps.instruction: Precipitate the nucleic acids using PEG and glycogen.

substeps.instruction: Add 2 µL RNA-grade glycogen and 1 mL (or twice the extract volume) of PEG Precipitation Solution to each tube.
Centrifuge at 14,000 rpm, 4 °C for 1 hour until a white/opaque pellet is visible.

steps.title: Wash and Dry Pellet
steps.instruction: Wash the pellet with ethanol and dry it.

substeps.instruction: Decant the supernatant and remove as much remaining solution as possible without disturbing the pellet.
Add 1 mL ice-cold 75% EtOH, invert several times, and centrifuge at 14,000 rpm, 4 °C for 20 minutes.
Remove the ethanol supernatant and remaining liquid using a pipette.
Dry the pellet for approximately 5 minutes at room temperature (under a flame, in a laminar-flow hood, inverted on kitchen paper, or via N2 stream/speed-vac).

steps.title: Resuspension
steps.instruction: Resuspend each pellet in 50 µL to 100 µL Low-EDTA TE Buffer and combine both subsamples into one non-stick tube.

steps.title: Optional Humic Substance Removal
steps.instruction: Remove co-extracted humic substances using the OneStep™ PCR Inhibitor Removal Kit.

substeps.instruction: Resuspend the resin in the column by brief vortexing (add 100 μl RNAse-free water if dry).
Loosen the cap by a quarter twist, place in a collection tube, and centrifuge at 8,000 x g, room temperature for 3 minutes.
Place the column in a fresh 1.5 ml tube and pipette the TNA extract (up to 200 μl) onto the resin.
Centrifuge at 8,000 x g, room temperature for 1 minute.
Discard the column and retain the extract.

steps.title: Analysis and Storage
steps.instruction: Evaluate and store the final total nucleic acid (TNA) extract.

substeps.instruction: Optional: Load 5 µL to 10 µL on an agarose gel for electrophoresis.
Quantify using RiboGreen™, PicoGreen™, or both.
Store work-templates in aliquots of 10 µL to 100 µL at -20 °C.
Optional: Aliquot 10 µL to 100 µL for RNA purification or perform RNaseH treatment if RNA removal is necessary.
